ai_review.summary: The evidence confirms that the cookie banner's reject option was successfully clicked, but it does not show any network requests, cookies, or other device storage occurring before consent or after rejection. The supplied policies describe advertising, analytics, recipients, lawful bases, retention and data-protection rights, so no separate evidenced breach can be identified from the available audit data.
evidence: E1: Cookie banner found: True. Reject clicked successfully: True. Method: selector. Buttons clicked: Reject optional cookies.

E2: Pages browsed and scrolled after reject: https://www.bp.com/press-and-publications/energy-in-focus-magazine/bp-and-castrol-ready-for-a-new-era, https://www.bp.com/investors/results-reporting-and-presentations/quarterly-results-and-webcast, https://careers.bp.com/listing.
E3: Privacy policy: https://www.bp.com/en/global/privacy/recruitment-notices.html. Companies it names: bp PLC. Contact email found: None.

controller_identity.label: Who is responsible (the controller)
controller_identity.quote: This Recruitment Privacy Notice (“Privacy Notice”) informs you of how your bp recruiting entity ("bp", "we", "us" or "our"), as data controller, processes your “Personal Information”.

purposes.label: What the data is used for
purposes.quote: Your Personal Information may be stored and processed by us in the following ways and for the following purposes (we have also set out the lawful basis that applies for each):

lawful_basis.label: The legal basis for using it
lawful_basis.quote: As such, where applicable, we will generally rely on one or more of the following lawful bases:

recipients.label: Who it is shared with
recipients.quote: We may share your Personal Information with third-party service providers, agents and contractors for the purposes of providing services to us

retention.label: How long it is kept
retention.quote: How long we will hold your Personal Information for will vary and will be determined by the purpose for which we are using it.

withdraw_consent.label: How to withdraw consent
withdraw_consent.quote: You can withdraw this consent at any time in your cookie preferences.

complain_to_regulator.label: Right to complain to the ICO
complain_to_regulator.quote: You also have the right to complain to your local data protection supervisory authority (regulator).
